metric_definitions.tLP: LPIPS-alex between adjacent frames, mean over T-1 pairs then over sequences
metric_definitions.MABD: |Y_t.mean() - Y_{t+1}.mean()| in luma [0,1], mean over T-1 pairs then over sequences
metric_definitions.flicker: per-pixel std of luma across T frames, then mean over pixels, then mean over sequences

meta.notes: LQ, GT, and image baselines (Retinexformer, HVI-CIDNet, DarkIR, URCSA) are run on RAW 512x512 center-crop of dataset frames. STCD, Seer (HMP-raw), and Seer+CP (HMP+CP) are extracted from the 5-column compare MP4 (LQ|HMP-raw|HMP+CP|STCD|GT) under /home/ma-user/workspace/zihaohe/visualizations/final_HMP_*. MP4 columns are cropped below the 36px label bar and center-cropped to 512x512. H264 compression in those MP4s could slightly smooth temporal high frequencies; this affects Seer and STCD equally and is a mild-conservative bias against them on the flicker metric. Temporal metrics are self-referential (adjacent frames within one method), so cross-method pixel alignment is not required.
